## Objective

One pure Core module derives a run inventory from the `RUN_STATE.md` files under `.agdf/control/runs/`. Every run appears once with a readable title, its stored lifecycle including `superseded` and `abandoned`, current gate, an attention class with its stored basis, last activity with its source, and revision. `doctor --all-active` and `agdf_inspect` are its first consumers, so humans on the CLI and agents on MCP read the same list. Later the companion and the hub can use the same module instead of their own list rules.

## Mode/Slice Decision

- decision: structured_delivery
- required_next_gate: PRD
- scope_reason: external_contract_depth. The change extends the public MCP read contract agdf_inspect shared by four hosts under a 5000-byte discovery budget and the doctor --all-active JSON report consumed by the SessionStart hook; quick_task and verified_change are ineligible because a new capability with new semantics spans CLI and MCP. Rejected alternative: structured_slice, because full_depth_impacts_absent fails on the public MCP and CLI contract change.
- evidence: This review (.agdf/control/artefacts/run-inventory-core-20261029-01/BROWNFIELD_REVIEW.md); approved UR revision 3; control-inspect/contract.js:17,46-48; selection.js:3-4; doctor.js:44-82; scripts/sync-plugin-runtime.js:350; request-activation.md.
